clauses.clause: Heroine keeps her colour in fog (no pale/transparent hero); bus hiding place readable at zoom 1.5.
clauses.note: Both tiers: fresh actual Sam-bus photo fixture with production female campaign model, no appearance/HP edits; physical KeyS12ticks after declared anchor selection. Standard camera reset removes the rejected stale cinematic blend: zoom1.5 and target within1m of actual courier. Personally reviewed full1280x720 frames: heroine retains opaque green clothing, teal pack, brown hair and orange/red shoes in the ash/fog; large brown wrecked bus, hood/door, wheels and stop-arm read clearly beside crushed cars, red tree and fence. Current physical idle/walk weapon frames and reached-metro frames independently show the same retained heroine colours later in the level. Controlled photo setup, not caption-only discovery or full physical route claim.
